name: Clinical Calculus
description: Complex case reasoning — equivocal discs, borderline fields, progressive myopia, prescribing dilemmas, risk communication, medico-legal awareness, and evidence-based practice.

episodes.title: Clinical Reasoning: The Bayesian Approach to the Eye
episodes.description: How pretest probability, the history, and the exam shift the odds and guide the workup.

episodes.title: Heuristics and Bias: The Cognitive Pitfalls of the Exam Room
episodes.description: Anchoring, availability, premature closure — the errors that lead to missed and delayed diagnoses.

episodes.title: The Differential Diagnosis: Building and Pruning the List
episodes.description: The anatomy-based and syndrome-based approaches, and the VINDICATE mnemonic for the systemic.

episodes.title: Red Flags in Optometry: The Never-Miss List
episodes.description: The symptoms and signs that demand same-day referral and the documentation that protects.

episodes.title: The Equivocal Disc: When Cup-to-Disc Is Borderline
episodes.description: The asymmetric and the suspicious — the OCT, the field, the family history, and the threshold to treat.

episodes.title: The Borderline Field: Reliability, Artifact, and Progression
episodes.description: Distinguishing true progression from noise, the GPA, and the decision to escalate.

episodes.title: To Treat or Not to Treat: The Ocular Hypertension Decision
episodes.description: The OHTS risk calculator, the shared decision, and the lifelong follow-up commitment.

episodes.title: The Prescribing Dilemma: When the Refraction Is Not the Answer
episodes.description: The child with high plus, the adult with a change, and the systemic and surface causes to consider.

episodes.title: Progressive Myopia: The Prescribing and the Control Decision
episodes.description: The adult and the child, the control options, and the risk-benefit conversation.

episodes.title: The Unexplained Vision Loss: The Workup Algorithm
episodes.description: From acuity to fields to OCT to imaging — the stepwise approach that finds the cause.

episodes.title: Malingering and Functional Loss: The Compassionate Assessment
episodes.description: The non-organic signs, the fogging and optokinetic tests, and the documentation and referral.

episodes.title: The Second Opinion: When the Patient Doubts
episodes.description: The chart review, the repeat exam, and the confirmation or correction that builds trust.

episodes.title: Risk Communication: The Probability and the Plain Language
episodes.description: How to convey risk so the patient decides — the absolute and relative, the framing, the numbers.

episodes.title: Shared Decision-Making: The Patient in the Plan
episodes.description: The evidence, the options, the values, and the conversation that places the patient at the center.

episodes.title: Medico-Legal Awareness: The Chart That Protects
episodes.description: The informed consent, the documentation, the referral, and the follow-up that define defensible care.

episodes.title: Evidence-Based Optometry: Reading the Study and Applying It
episodes.description: The hierarchy of evidence, the PEDIG and OHTS examples, and the clinical question that guides the search.

episodes.title: The Diagnostic Test: Sensitivity, Specificity, and the Likelihood Ratio
episodes.description: How to read a test study and the pretest-posttest probability that changes the plan.

episodes.title: The Incidentaloma: The Finding You Were Not Looking For
episodes.description: The disc drusen, the choroidal nevus, the optic pit — the approach to the unexpected.

episodes.title: When to Refer: The Threshold and the Timing
episodes.description: The urgent, the soon, and the elective — the framework that guides the referral letter.

episodes.title: The Referral Letter: The Structure and the Content
episodes.description: The question, the findings, the imaging, the urgency, and the continuity that the letter achieves.

episodes.title: Co-Management: The Shared Care and the Communication
episodes.description: The post-op, the chronic disease, the comorbidities, and the role definition that prevents gaps.

episodes.title: The Difficult Patient: The Angry, the Non-Adherent, the Frequent
episodes.description: The de-escalation, the motivational interviewing, and the boundary-setting that sustains the relationship.

episodes.title: Breaking Bad News: The SPIKES Protocol at the Eye Exam
episodes.description: The setting, the perception, the invitation, the knowledge, the empathy, and the strategy and summary.

episodes.title: End-of-Life Care and the Eye: The Comfort Focus
episodes.description: The vision that matters, the environment, the family, and the dignity that defines the care.

episodes.title: The Missed Appointment: The Recall and the Risk
episodes.description: The system, the outreach, the documentation, and the liability that follows the no-show.

episodes.title: Cultural Competence: The Eye Care Across Differences
episodes.description: The language, the beliefs, the health literacy, and the adaptation that builds trust.

episodes.title: The Longitudinal Patient: The 40-Year Relationship
episodes.description: The records, the rapport, the transitions, and the joy and burden of the decades.

episodes.title: Continuing Education: The Lifelong Learning Discipline
episodes.description: The journals, the courses, the colleagues, and the curiosity that keeps the practice current.

episodes.title: Burnout, Moral Distress, and the Optometrist
episodes.description: The signs, the system causes, the individual strategies, and the structural change that sustains.

episodes.title: The Art of Optometry: The Science and the Human
episodes.description: The evidence, the experience, the empathy, and the integration that defines the excellent clinician.
